description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
修改后的VNC远程可视化服务的连接密码。长度为6个字符，必须同时包含英文字母和数字。
>请务必使用HTTPS协议调用API以避免可能发生的密码泄露。
description.en:
The password that you can use to remotely connect to the visualization service over the VNC. The password must be 6 characters in length and must contain letters and digits.

>  You must call the API operation over HTTPS to ensure that the password remains confidential.

description.zh: 集群的用户名。当前仅支持root用户。
description.en: The username of the cluster. Set the value to root.
The password that corresponds to the username specified by RunasUser.

title.zh: 设置VNC服务远程连接密码

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc modify-visual-service-passwd --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --runas-user root --runas-user-password 21450000 --passwd 12540000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
